topic_title: Colors and Shapes of Signs, Signals & Pavement Markings
prompt: What is the legal mandate when confronting a square white sign displaying a solid red circle and white bar?

options.text: Do Not Enter; entry is strictly prohibited because traffic flows toward you
Authorized vehicles may enter during daytime non-peak traffic intervals
Stop completely, sound your horn twice, then proceed if street is clear
Commercial transport vehicles must detour into the adjacent right lane
